description: Pavement Condition Index is a dataset listed in Montgomery County open data portal (data.montgomerycountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Montgomery County. Pavement Condition Index is provided by the Department of Transportation for analyzing the conditions of the pavement for all 5,200 lane miles of roadways within the County. Pavement Condition Index or PCI is a numerical expression between 0-100 numerically representing the pavements condition. Coverage: Montgomery County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are pavement, roadway, road, potholes, condition. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department Transportation. The portal shows 2019-04-17 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-montgomerycountymd-gov-portal.
